description: This file defines the SugarConfig class, which manages configuration settings in the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods for retrieving configuration values, caching them, and clearing the cache.

classes.name: SugarConfig
classes.description: A class responsible for managing configuration settings, including fetching, caching, and cache invalidation.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the SugarConfig class.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration value by key, optionally returning a default if the key is not set.

methods.name: clearCache
methods.description: Clears the cached configuration values; can clear all or a specific key.
